title: Exterior Finishes

stage.name: Weather-tight
stage.description: Roof, windows, doors and siding: the house is sealed against the weather.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of the roof and siding?
options: Keeping weather out of the house
questions.why: A house's outer skin keeps rain, wind and sun from damaging what's inside.

questions.prompt: Put the usual order of exterior work.
items: Gutters are hung to carry rain away
questions.why: Builders work from the top down so water always runs over finished work, not under it.

questions.prompt: Flashing is thin material that steers water away from joints, like around windows and chimneys.
questions.why: Most leaks happen where two surfaces meet. Flashing covers those seams.

questions.prompt: How do strong couples treat each other in front of others?
options: With respect, even when they disagree
With jokes at the other's expense
questions.why: Being on the same side in public builds trust in private.

talk: How would you like to show up together with family and friends?
